script.title: How Matter Spirals into a Black Hole
script.description: Watch how friction drains the energy of orbiting gas until it slips past the event horizon.

shots.narration: A cloud of gas loops safely in space, held in place by the steady pull of a heavy black hole.
Rubbing together, the swirling streams heat up, lose their balance, and slowly drift inward toward the dark center.
Once the gas slips past the dark edge, it vanishes from view entirely, and no light can ever return.
